name: com.isu_sdmay25_40.hybrid_relightable_3d_gaussian_rendering
description: Convert video into realistic 3D Gaussian models using machine learning techniques. These models integrate seamlessly into Unity and are rendered in real-time using our hybrid path-tracing pipeline.

author.name: Jackson Vanderheyden, Brian Xicon, Luke Broglio, Ethan Gasner, Kyle Kohl
